record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare WHIRLPOOL: Horsea (1 star), Seadra (2 stars), Kingdra (3 stars); all have range 2 and maxPP 100 per the unit blocks (the cast does not use range). The strategy is shared; the unit difference is the star count (multiplier index) and the unit's own current ATK.
record.summary: The caster picks its farthest targettable unit (PokemonState.getFarthestTarget) or, if none, the cast target, walks the straight line of cells from itself to it and takes only the FIRST unit of another team on that line (not every unit, and not necessarily the farthest one). That unit, or the cast target if the line holds no enemy, takes four consecutive SPECIAL hits, each of requested size current ATK x 1 (x 2 only at 4 stars or as the fallback), so for these units four hits of the caster's current ATK. No status effect.

targeting.who: the first unit of another team met on the supercover line from the caster toward its farthest targettable unit; fallback: the cast target
targeting.note: Selection of the farthest target is by distanceM over targettable units (strictly greater wins; first in board scan order on ties). The line is walked from the caster's own cell; allies on it are skipped by the team filter, and the first enemy stops the walk, so the farthest target is hit only if nothing else stands in front of it. The collection filter is team only, not isTargettableBy. The fallback is whichever unit the generic code passed as the cast target.

geometry.shape: straight line (supercover) from the caster's cell to the cell of its farthest targettable unit, both ends included when on board; only the first enemy on it is a victim, so the result is a single target

effects.target: the first enemy on the line; else the cast target

declaredRaw.unit: multiplier of the caster's current ATK, per hit; four hits per cast

effects.scaling: requested per hit = pokemon.atk (the caster's current ATK at the moment of each call, buffs and debuffs included) x multiplier. handleSpecialDamage on each hit: x (1 + AP/100) because apBoost defaults to true; x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite on the target) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so it needs ABILITY_CRIT); the DOUBLE_DAMAGE and steam-board multipliers recorded for AQUA_TAIL apply since it is the same function. The four calls are made back to back, so the requested size is the same for all four (ATK does not change within the loop).
effects.resolution: requested (ATK x 1) -> applied per hit (after AP and crit) -> handleDamage: attacker/field/weather multipliers, division by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounded up with a minimum of 1 for EACH hit, target shield absorbing first. takenDamage reported per hit = shield damage + HP damage (capped at current hp); 0 for a target with protect / skydiving / magicBounce (each of the four hits is blocked separately). The strategy ignores every return value, so the loop continues even if an earlier hit killed the target. With a Cover Band ally adjacent, handleDamage redirects the hit to that ally. Requested, applied and takenDamage are different numbers; the minimum of 1 applies four times, which matters for a very low ATK.

starBehavior.note: Only the multiplier is indexed by stars: 1 at 1-3 stars, 2 at 4 stars or as the fallback (not reachable at the bare factory star counts of these units). The units differ in the result through their own ATK (base atk 6 / 11 / 21 in the unit blocks, before any buff or debuff). Whether other mechanics raise a star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Which enemy is hit depends on the caster's and the farthest target's coordinates and on what stands first on the line. If the farthest target is adjacent, the line is two cells. Allies on the line are not affected and do not block the line. If getFarthestTarget returns nothing the cast target ends the line.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast recomputes the farthest target and the line, spends maxPP of PP (floor 0) and deals its four hits again. The default animation is suppressed; one ability broadcast is sent at the first enemy's cell.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: four hits, each of the caster's current ATK x 1 at 1-3 stars (a multiplier of a live stat, not a table of flat amounts). Applied per hit = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then reduced by the target's SPE_DEF with a minimum of 1 per hit; takenDamage per hit includes shield damage. The total across the four hits is not four times a single resolved number when the target's shield or hp runs out mid-loop. Final values additionally depend on untraced item and field effects.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located

Damage resolution after handleDamage's earlier branches (e.g. Shiny Charm, Fossil shield, resurrection, passives, weather and field multipliers) was only partly read: protect, Cover Band redirect, SPE_DEF division, minimum 1 and shield absorption were read; later death handling was not
Whether the 500 ms magicBounce reflection or Power Lens retaliation matters: they were read in handleSpecialDamage but not simulated
unresolved: Distance ties in getFarthestTarget keep the first in board scan order; the scan order of board.forEach itself was not traced
Whether the line can include untargettable enemies or units behind obstacles: the collection filter is team only, not isTargettableBy, and the first enemy on the line is taken regardless
What the remaining hits do when an earlier hit kills the target or a death handler runs (the loop has no guard; later death handling was not traced)
Whether the three units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
